entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-8m2g-8cgm-3vcp: DeepSeek Harness contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in local HTTP control-plane API
entry.content:
DeepSeek Harness contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in local HTTP control-plane API

Aliases: CVE-2026-82533

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H

Affected:

  • @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection — fixed in 0.1.2-alpha.1

DeepSeek Harness before 0.1.2-alpha.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its local HTTP control-plane API that allows attackers to gain full agent control by supplying a spoofed Host header, as the server validates only the client-supplied Host header value rather than the actual TCP connection origin. Attackers can exploit this flaw to invoke privileged commands such as commands/execute with danger-full-access permissions, escalate session approval policies to unconfined execution, and retrieve all stored conversations without any credential or API key.

Next.js: Pending `use cache` fill can leak Draft Mode content into regular responses and persisted pages

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-4jqv-mc3x-m676: Next.js has cache poisoning of SSG and ISR pages in self-hosted applications
entry.content:
Next.js has cache poisoning of SSG and ISR pages in self-hosted applications

Aliases: CVE-2026-94543

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • next — fixed in 15.5.27
  • next — fixed in 16.3.8

Self-hosted Next.js applications that use the Pages Router with statically generated (SSG) or incrementally regenerated (ISR) pages can have a page's cache entry replaced with content from a different route, causing the affected page to serve wrong content to every visitor until the entry is revalidated. Applications deployed on Vercel are not affected.

References:
